criteria.name: ML Model Development
criteria.guidance: Assess appropriate machine learning models, reproducible pipelines, suitable train/test split, and sound model implementation.

criteria.name: Hyperparameter Tuning & Validation
criteria.guidance: Assess cross-validation, search strategy, leakage prevention, tuning choices, and reproducibility.

criteria.name: Model Comparison & Performance Evaluation
criteria.guidance: Assess comparison using suitable metrics, confusion matrix, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC where appropriate, and interpretation.

criteria.name: Risk Factor / Feature Importance Analysis
criteria.guidance: Assess feature importance or model interpretability, direction and relevance of risk factors, and limitations.

criteria.name: Clustering & Borrower Segmentation
criteria.guidance: Assess clustering approach, feature preparation, selection/justification of cluster count, segment profiling, and business interpretation.
